sloka: विश्रुतः त्रिषु लोकेषु वदान्यः सत्य संगरः ।स तत्र पुरुषव्याघ्रः शशास पृथ्वीम् इमाम् ॥१-७-२२॥
transliteration: viśrutaḥ triṣu lokeṣu vadānyaḥ satya saṁgaraḥ ।sa tatra puruṣavyāghraḥ śaśāsa pṛthvīm imām ॥1-7-22॥

translations.english: Accompanied by the ministers who were devoted to his welfare, adept in counselling, skilful, capable and loyal towards him, the king acquired glory like the rising Sun with luminous rays. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे सप्तमस्सर्ग: ।। Thus ends the seventh sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
